headline: Lock in your pass.
description: Checkout runs on PurplePass — pick a tier, split the total into three payments at checkout, and your wristband waits at will-call.
fine_print: Prices include all fees. Payment plans via Klarna / Affirm at PurplePass checkout. Transferable until 10 days before the festival. No refunds.

tiers.name: Grey Pack
perks: Festival admission + commemorative ticket + poster + festival tee.

tiers.name: Wolf Pack
perks: Festival admission + commemorative ticket + tee + tote + laminate + poster + front-of-line entry.
